quotes.text: Activity event status line should report the elapsed time

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: SendTracker.flush rounds the completed batch span to at least one second, formats it with Intl.DurationFormat and supplies count/time to extension-sent-activity-event-status. Fluent pluralizes the count and embeds the duration string. The single-message test asserts count and duration substrings separately, so it does not prove exact combined wording, all locales or idle-timer expiry.
title: Completed extension send status receives a localized duration string
